Sasha: Heads-up  Sales pushed a batch called 'pricing-sandbox' into Zuora this morning. Total credits = $62,500 across 12 customers. Need quick guidance for month-end: some credits look like refunds for Apr usage, others look like prepaid credits for a pilot extension.

Mina: Important to separate types. If it's refund for consumption already recognized => correction. If it's credit toward future service => deferred liability. Mixed batches complicate auto-posting.

Omar: Can we get the credit memo notes? Need to map each memo to original invoice and contract term. I'll pull mapping now.

AccountingBot: billing_event: batch=2026-06-28-sandbox, credits_created=12, total_credit=62500.00, labels="pricing-sandbox", memos=[60011..60022]

Sasha: I spot-checked a few: memo 60012 note="extension-credit-July" (looks like future), 60014 note="refund-Apr15-usage" (past). So mixed.

Mina: Operational plan: 1) Tag memos as REFUND vs FUTURE; 2) Hold auto RCS reversals until mapping complete; 3) For REFUND: compute product-period impact and check materiality; 4) For FUTURE: create deferred liability entries and schedule amortization.

Omar: I've placed a hold on NetSuite posting for the whole batch. Extracting invoice->rsc_id mapping and contract start/end dates now. ETA 1 hour.

AccountingBot: hold_applied: memos=[60011..60022], action_by=Sasha, ts=2026-06-28T09:15:00Z

Mina: Example journals: For refund (catch-up if immaterial):

```
DR Sales Returns & Allowances   3,250.00
  CR Accounts Receivable         3,250.00
DR Revenue Adjustment (contra)  3,250.00
  CR Revenue                     3,250.00
```

Mina: For deferred pilot credit (move to liability and amortize over extension term):

```
DR Sales Returns & Allowances   5,000.00
  CR Accounts Receivable         5,000.00
DR Deferred Revenue              5,000.00
  CR Revenue                     5,000.00   # reclassify to deferred
```

Sasha: Good. Also flag any single-customer concentration where a refund >5% of that product-quarter revenue could trigger restatement risk. Our restatement policy: 5% of product-quarter revenue or $250k absolute.

Omar: Mapping done: 8 memos are FUTURE extension credits totalling $30k; 4 memos are REFUNDS totalling $32,500. None of the refunds cross the 5% threshold for any single product-quarter based on quick checks.

Mina: If refunds are immaterial by product, treat as current-period catch-up. For the future credits, set up deferred revenue schedules tied to contract extension periods.

Sasha: Action items: (1) Omar to upload mapping + list of revenue schedule ids; (2) Accounting to post catch-up contra-revenue for refunds in June; (3) Ops to create deferred schedules for future credits and amortize per extension; (4) Sales ops to use a short intake form so mixed batches are avoided.

AccountingBot: actions_created: ACTION-601 (upload mapping), ACTION-602 (post catch-up journals), ACTION-603 (create deferred schedules)

Omar: Uploaded mapping to /finance/month-end/credit-mapping/pricing-sandbox.xlsx and removed holds on FUTURE memos only. REFUND memos remain held until Accounting posts catch-up entries.

Mina: I'll prepare the GL postings and run a quick variance report to ensure no unexpected P&L hit. ETA 4 hours.

Sasha: Thanks team  this mixed-case guidance is helpful. We'll update the month-end playbook with the REFUND vs FUTURE tagging step. :thumbsup:
